python3 -c '
from pathlib import Path
import re
text = Path("experiment-data/negation-32k.txt").read_text()
instances = []
for line in text.splitlines():
    if "|| Instance: " in line:
        instances.append(line.split("|| Instance: ", 1)[1])
print(len(instances))
# Detect negation heuristically
neg_pats = [
    r"\bnot a single\b", r"\bin no context\b", r"\bin any context\b",
    r"\bnever\b", r"\bdoes not\b", r"\bdo not\b", r"\bis not\b", r"\bare not\b",
    r"\bmay not\b", r"\bdoes never\b", r"\bis never\b", r"\bdo never\b",
    r"^No \w+", r"^Not a single", r"\bno context\b",
]
# Count how many have negation markers
def is_neg(s):
    sl = s
    # "in certain contexts" is affirmative
    # "in no context" / "in any context" with negative framing
    if re.search(r"\bin no context\b", sl, re.I):
        return True
    if re.search(r"\bin any context\b", sl, re.I) and re.search(r"\b(not|never|no)\b", sl, re.I):
        return True
    if re.search(r"\bnot a single\b", sl, re.I):
        return True
    if re.search(r"\bdoes never\b|\bis never\b|\bdo never\b|\bnever\b", sl, re.I):
        return True
